correctness.rationale: For dV=kappa dW, dX=V dt, Gaussian Kac–Rice gives conditional velocity mean v0+3(u-v0t)/(2t), variance kappa²t/4 and the two explicit erfc/erf H_u,H_v crossing kernels. Their z-scaled derivative functions G_u,G_v are positive below first thresholds and negative above second, while positive integral representations imply E_j′/E_j ≤1/z. In intermediate intervals the P_u,P_v logarithmic derivatives are strictly negative (bounds <−2 and <−20 respectively), so each time kernel has exactly one peak. Splitting -∫t e^(−rt)h′ as B−A, the ratio A/B is strictly increasing 0→∞ by separated support, proving exactly one global r maximum. Independent scipy quadrature reconstructed s_u≈0.520327681 and s_v≈0.505942998, and rates ≈0.1046702621 and 0.05846588284, in agreement at numerical precision; original code verify.py was read. Reset jumps are excluded. Decimal values are not certified intervals.
